items.t: CONTRACT OF LEASE
KNOWN ALL MEN BY THESE PRESENTS:
This Contract of Lease entered into this
10th of September 2026
at
San. Fernando
Pampanga, Philippines,
by and between
KHYLE CHRISTIAN JAMES
, of legal age, Filipino, with address at
# 221 Mabini St., Davsan
Subd., Sindalan, City of San. Fernando, Pampanga
, hereinafter referred to as the
"LESSOR"
-and-
NATHANIA M. MONTAÑEZ
, of legal age, Filipino, hereinafter called the "
LESSEE
WITNESSETH: that -
The LESSOR represents that he/she has acquired rights and interest over the leased premises
through a prior agreement and has the legal right and authority to lease the same. The LESSOR
further agrees to provide proof of such rights and authority upon reasonable request by the
LESSEE. The leased premises are located at the following address and described as follows:
A residential house located at
BLOCK 83, LOT 20, BRIDGEPOINTE, DEL ROSARIO, CITY OF
SAN. FERNANDO, PAMPANGA
, with a total floor area of 40 square meters (more or less), with
1 toilet and bath
SEMI-FURNISHED
, hereinafter referred to as the "
LEASED PREMISES"
The LESSEE, who shall be responsible for all his/her acts and omissions, desires to lease the
above described premises, and the LESSOR is willing to lease the same unto the LESSEE
under the following terms and conditions.
I.
TERM
This agreement shall be for a period of
1 year commencing on September 10,
2026 to September 10, 2027
subject to renewal of the parties on mutually
agreed terms. Any renewal/extension hereof shall be subject to separate
agreement.
II.
RENTAL
The LESSEE hereby agrees to pay the LESSOR the amount of Six Thousand
Five Hundred & 00/100 Only (₱ 6,500.00) Philippine Currency every month for
the entire term of this contract. Rent shall be due on or before the
5th day of
each month
, payable at the LESSOR’s designated address or through such
mode as the LESSOR may specify.
III.
SECURITY DEPOSIT
Upon execution of this Contract, the LESSEE shall pay to the LESSOR the
equivalent of one (1) month advance rent and one (1) month security deposit +
Utilities, in the total amount of P 15,000 Philippine Currency.
The one (1) month advance rent shall be applied to the first month of the lease
term.
The security deposit shall answer for any unpaid rent, utility bills, and damages to
the leased premises beyond normal wear and tear incurred during the term of the
lease. The security deposit shall not be applied to monthly rental payments.
The security deposit shall be refunded to the LESSEE within thirty (30) days from
the date the LESSEE vacates the premises and surrenders possession thereof to
the LESSOR, subject to deductions for any unpaid obligations.
In the event that the LESSEE pre-terminates or abandons this Agreement prior to
its expiration, the LESSOR shall have the right to forfeit the security deposit,
without prejudice to other remedies available under the law.
The security deposit may also serve as a reservation fee prior to the actual
contract date. In case the LESSEE decides not to proceed with the lease before
the contract date, the security deposit shall be forfeited in favor of the LESSOR.
IV.
NOTICE OF DISENGAGEMENT
The LESSEE shall give the LESSOR at least thirty (30) days written notice before
vacating the leased premises. Rent and utilities must be paid during this period.
Failure to provide timely notice may result in forfeiture of the security deposit. The
premises must be returned in good condition, with all keys and access devices
surrendered to the LESSOR.
V.
RENEWAL
The LESSEE may renew this lease upon expiration, subject to the LESSOR’s
written approval. Renewal terms, including rent and duration, shall be mutually
agreed upon in writing at least thirty (30) days before the lease’s expiration. All
other provisions of this agreement shall continue to apply during the renewal
period unless otherwise amended in writing.
VI.
TERMINATION OR CANCELLATION OF LEASE
This lease shall be automatically terminated if any of the following events
supervene:
Upon expiration of the lease period in the original contract, unless the
lease relationship is extended or renewed in the manner provided in this
contract;
Failure to comply with any of the Conditions of this Contract;
Use of the premises for purposes other than what is agreed upon;
Failure to comply with any provision of the House Rules and Regulations,
as well as with any policies that may be issued out periodically by the
LESSOR.
VII.
UTILITIES
The LESSEE shall pay all utilities and related services, including electricity,
water, homeowners’ association (HOA) dues, Wi-Fi/internet, and other services
for the leased premises. The LESSEE shall remit payment to the LESSOR for the
corresponding utility bills and applicable charges at least five (5) days prior to the
due date of such bills, upon receipt of the Statement of Account.
The LESSOR shall issue an acknowledgment or receipt for all payments made,
and the LESSEE may request proof of payment of such utilities from the
LESSOR.
If the LESSEE fails to remit payment within the required period, including cases
of dishonored or returned checks, the LESSEE agrees to pay a penalty of three
percent (3%) interest per month, in addition to any other applicable charges.
VIII.
USE OF PREMISES
The LESSEE hereby expressly agrees and warrants that the leased premises
shall be occupied and used exclusively by the LESSEE for Residential purposes
and for no other purpose without prior written consent of the LESSOR.
LESSEE shall not use the premises for any immoral or illegal activities nor
divert/convert the premises to other uses. The leased units shall not be used for
any activities prohibited by law. Neither shall the unit be used in any activities that
may disturb the peace or cause disturbances of whatever nature to other tenants.
Any violation of the foregoing restrictions shall result to the termination of this
lease and removal of the tenant from the premises.
IX.
RULES, REGULATIONS, ETC.
The LESSEE shall not use or store in any part of the leased premises anything
prohibited by law, whether local or national, without prejudice to the criminal
liability of the LESSEE therefore under the Revised Penal Code and other special
laws. The LESSEE shall comply strictly with any and all rules and safety
regulations which may be imposed from time to time by the LESSOR and with all
the laws made by duly constituted authorities of the City or National Government
arising from or regarding the use, occupancy and sanitation of the leased
premises.
X.
VIOLATIONS
Any violation, direct or indirect, of any of the provisions herein stipulated shall be
sufficient ground for termination of this Contract. The LESSEE moreover agrees
to forfeit the one (1) month security deposit as penalty for such violations.
XI.
PROHIBITIONS
The LESSEE shall not bring into or store within the leased premises any
flammable, explosive, or hazardous materials, including those subject to
spontaneous combustion, nor conduct any activity that may increase the risk of
fire or damage to the property.
The LESSEE shall be liable for any damage caused by such prohibited materials
or activities. Any increase in insurance premiums or related costs resulting from
the LESSEE’s actions shall be for the account of the LESSEE.
XII.
DEFAULT AND BREACH OF COVENANTS, ABANDONMENT OF THE LEASED
PREMISES
The leased Premises shall conclusively be considered to have been abandoned
upon the occurrence of any of the following events. And one (1) month security
deposit shall be forfeited in favor of the LESSOR.
The leased premises is vacated, deserted or abandoned continuously for
a period of at least thirty (30) days, without prior notice to the LESSOR,
before the expiration or termination of the Lease;
LESSEE is in arrear of three (3) months rental, or three (3) month utility
and/or other billings.
XIII.
NOTICES
The LESSOR can notify the LESSEE by email or by posting a notice at the
property. Once done, the notice is considered officially received, even if the
LESSEE doesn’t accept it or isn’t home.
XIV.
DAMAGE TO THE LEASED PREMISES
In case of damage to the leased premises or its appurtenances by fire,
earthquake, war, or any other unforeseen cause, the LESSEE shall give
immediate notice thereof to the LESSOR. If the leased premises shall be
damaged by fire or other unforeseen cause without the fault or negligence of the
LESSEE or his agents, employees, or visitors, the damage shall be repaired at
the expense of the LESSOR within a reasonable time after such notice; however,
if the house leased premises is destroyed to such an extent as to make it
untenable without the fault or neglect of the LESSEE, either party may demand
the rescission of this contract.
The LESSOR shall not be liable to the LESSEE for any damage which such
destruction may cause to the LESSEE, and no compensation or claims shall be
allowed against the LESSOR by reason of any inconvenience, annoyance, or
injury to the LESSEE arising out of the necessity of repairing any portion of the
house, whenever the necessity may arise.
In case of damage to the leased premises or its appurtenances by fire or any
unforeseen cause which was caused by the LESSEE’s negligence or fault, or by
his agents, employees, or visitors, then the damage shall be repaired at the
expense of the LESSEE, and the leased premises shall be brought back to its
original condition.
XV.
LIABILITY FOR SUITS, ETC.
The LESSEE agrees to indemnify and hold the LESSOR harmless from any
claims, damages, or liabilities arising from the LESSEE’s use of the leased
premises. This does not affect the LESSOR’s right to terminate the lease
according to the terms of this contract.
XVI.
SUBLEASE AND TRANSFER OF RIGHTS
The LESSEE shall not assign, transfer, mortgage, or sublease the leased
premises, in whole or in part, without the prior written consent of the LESSOR.
Any unauthorized assignment or sublease shall be null and void, and the
LESSOR may terminate this contract immediately. In such cases, all rental and
security deposits shall be forfeited. The LESSOR has the right to prevent any
unauthorized person from entering the premises.
XVII.
IMPROVEMENTS, REPAIRS AND MAINTENANCE
The LESSEE acknowledges that the leased premises are in good and tenantable
condition and agrees to keep them clean, safe, and free from nuisances. Waste
and garbage must be properly contained and disposed of as instructed by the
LESSOR.
The LESSEE must promptly notify the LESSOR of any damage, unauthorized
use, or threats to the premises. The LESSOR may conduct necessary repairs for
maintenance or preservation, and shall not be liable for any inconvenience
caused during such work. Major repairs due to structural defects are for the
LESSOR’s account, while damages caused by the LESSEE’s negligence are at
the LESSEE’s expense.
The LESSEE shall not make alterations, improvements, or install additional
locksets, deadlocks, or nails on walls, doors, or other parts of the premises
without the prior written consent of the LESSOR.
Upon lease expiration, the LESSEE shall return the premises in the same
condition as received, reasonable wear and tear excepted.
XVIII.
ACCESS TO PREMISES
The LESSOR or its authorized agent shall have the right to enter the leased
premises at reasonable times with prior notice, except in emergencies to
examine the same, to make repairs, or for any purpose which it may deem
necessary for the operation or maintenance of the house, and to exhibit the
leased premises to prospective tenants.
No compensation or claim shall be made against the LESSOR by reason of any
inconvenience, annoyance, or injury to the LESSEE that may arise by virtue of
undertaking any work or activity under this provision.
XIX.
RETURN OF PREMISES
Upon the expiration or termination of this lease, the LESSEE agrees to promptly
vacate and surrender the leased premises to the LESSOR in good condition,
reasonable wear and tear excepted. The premises must be free of all occupants,
furniture, belongings, and personal effects, without any delay.
XX.
DISTURBANCE
Disturbance or discontinuance of the possession of the leased premises by the
LESSEE due to causes beyond the control of LESSOR shall confer no right of
any kind to the LESSEE as against the LESSOR.
XXI.
NON-WAIVER
The failure of the LESSOR to insist upon LESSEE a strict performance of any of
the conditions herein shall not be deemed as relinquishment or waiver of any
right or remedy that said LESSOR may have, nor shall it be construed as a
waiver of any subsequent breach or default of the conditions herein, which
conditions shall continue to be in full force and effect, unless such waiver shall
have been expressed in writing and signed by the LESSOR.
XXII.
RIGHT TO TAKE OVER POSSESSION
Upon failure of the LESSEE to comply with the terms and conditions of the lease,
the LESSOR shall have the right, upon FIVE (5) days written notice to the
LESSEE, or in his absence, upon written notice posted at the entrance of the
premises leased, to enter and take possession of the premises.
XXIII.
JUDICIAL RELIEF OR PENALTY
Should the LESSOR be compelled to seek judicial relief against the LESSEE, the
latter shall, in addition to any other damages that may be awarded to the
LESSOR, pay an amount equivalent to 25% of the amount claimed in the
complaint, and by way of attorney's fees (with a minimum of P10,000.00) aside
from the costs of litigation and other expenses which the laws may entitle the
LESSOR to recover from the LESSEE.
XXIV.
FORCE MAJEURE
The LESSOR shall not be liable for any injuries or damage caused by any
circumstance of force majeure. Force majeure is any event beyond the
reasonable control of either party including, but not limited to war, whether
declared or not, rebellion, fire, flooding, and other natural calamities.
XXV.
SEPARABILITY CLAUSE
In the event that any paragraph, subparagraph or part of this contract of lease
shall be declared contrary to law or public policy, or is otherwise declared invalid,
such paragraph, subparagraph or part shall not affect the validity of the remaining
provisions or stipulations hereof.
XXVI.
VENUE
Any action arising out of or in connection with this Contract shall be brought
before the appropriate court within the jurisdiction of the City of San. Fernando, to
the exclusion of all other courts.
XXVII.
OTHER PROVISIONS
All remedies granted to the LESSOR under this Contract or elsewhere shall be
cumulative.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties hereto have signed these presents on the date and place
first above written.
KHYLE CHRSTIAN G. JAMES
